Name: Stardew Valley Calico Cat (Please read description)
Author: frostychica
Description:
A simple calico recolor. This replaces the first orange cat. I'm not sure how to change the sprite in the character creator, so just pick the orange one! ^^ If you want to keep the orange cat, just put a number between 1 and 5 to the end of the file name to replace a different one.

To install: copy the mod file, go to C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals and replace "cat.xnb". THIS WILL OVERWRITE THE ORIGINAL FILE, SO BE SURE TO SAVE A BACKUP COPY!

Feel free to edit as you please to match your own calico :) Just link back here
